displayPattern: Shown on the control board 7-segment display: EE3 (circulator blower runs continuously, no heat)
causes: Insufficient conditioned air over the heat exchanger
Improper circulator blower speed or failed circulator blower motor
Loose or improperly connected wiring in the high limit circuit
diySteps: Turn off power, then check and clean or replace the air filter
Make sure supply and return registers are open and not blocked
Technician: check circulator blower speed and performance; correct speed or replace motor if necessary
Technician: tighten or correct wiring in the high limit circuit
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: if a clean filter and open registers do not clear the code, or it returns.
